summary: 65 types, 86 FBX variants replacing 161 W85 placeholder boxes (of 226 box props in Data/v02; the rest are listed under not_mine).
data_source: Assets/OnlyVolunteers/Map/W85Build/Data/v02/districts/*.json + details_v85.json (box props = W85Builder.Prop fallback, no PrefabOf entry)

conventions.frame: Every model is built in the frame of the placeholder box it replaces: Unity local X = data size[0], local Z = data size[1], +Y up; pivot = centre of the base on the ground (P(pos), y = terrain height).
conventions.fbx: Blender Z up / front -Y exported with axis_forward -Z, axis_up Y, apply_unit_scale, FBX_SCALE_UNITS, bake_space_transform (same as GRANDPA_YARD_v01 / FACADE_KIT_v01): Blender -Y -> Unity +Z, root rotation identity, 1 unit = 1 m.
conventions.hierarchy: root MW86_<Type>_<Var> -> <root>_LOD0 + <root>_LOD1 (Unity auto-creates the LODGroup; suggested screen heights 0.35 / 0.08 / cull 0.01) or a single <root>_Mesh when <= 1000 tris; plus UCX_<root>_NN convex collider meshes.
conventions.colliders: UCX_* children -> convex MeshCollider on the child and remove its MeshRenderer (exactly what W85Builder Kit() already does for FACADE_KIT pieces). Without that step the UCX boxes RENDER. No other colliders needed.
conventions.components: Keep W85Builder.Prop behaviour on the root: W76GripAnchor for grip kinds (bollard, ...), W76LeaveCountryButton for leave_country_button, static flags BatchingStatic | OccludeeStatic on all renderers.

material.name: MW86_StaticPalette_v01 (one material for every M2 prop; FBX materials carry this name -> remap by name)
material.metallic_map: Textures/MW86_StaticPalette_v01_MetallicSmoothness.png (sRGB OFF; R = metallic, A = smoothness; Smoothness Source = Metallic Alpha, smoothness 1)
material.emission: on; Emission Map = Textures/MW86_StaticPalette_v01_Emission.png (sRGB), colour white, HDR intensity ~1.5 (neon heart, lantern, screen, fire embers, beacons, displays; the other swatches are black)
material.texture_import: 256 px, Generate Mip Maps OFF (16 px flat swatches - mips would blend neighbours), Filter Point or Bilinear, Compression None, Wrap Clamp
